name: component-wall
title: Component Wall
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A landing hero for a component library: on the right a wall of screenshots that never ends, a camera gliding from card to card; on the left a headline that blurs in word by word and keeps one word turning, a lead, an install command that names whichever card the camera is resting on, two actions and a line of trust; over the lower part of the wall, the tools it is built with in batches.
docs: Named export: ComponentWall (plus the ComponentWallItem and StackTool types). Composed from the image-wall, text-animation, copy-button, avatar-stack and half-stars items, which install alongside it. Pass `badge` ({ label, href? }), `heading` (a string, revealed word by word; write `{word}` where `headingWords` take turns every `wordInterval` ms, and name one word in `accent` for the primary colour), `description`, `install` ({ command } — write `{item}` where the focused card's `slug` goes, e.g. `npx shadcn@latest add @algorize-ui/{item}`), `primaryAction`/`secondaryAction` ({ label, href, icon? }), `trust` ({ text, avatars?, rating? }), `items` ({ title, image, slug? }[] — every screenshot sits in the same 493:332 frame; slug defaults to the title in kebab-case) and `stack` ({ label?, groups: { name, icon }[][], interval? } — the tools over the lower wall, one batch of four to eight at a time, an odd batch as three over four; names from xl up). `columns`, `interval` (ms the camera rests; 0 holds still), `order` (serial | shuffle), `zoom` and `onFocus` pass straight to the wall; `linkComponent` takes next/link. The headline uses your theme's font-serif, the command font-mono; colours are theme tokens.
